nodes.name: Telegram Trigger
nodes.notes: Orange Park Telegram v3 trigger. Placeholder credential name only; token is stored in n8n credentials, not this export.

nodes.name: Normalize Telegram Message
nodes.notes: Normalizes private Telegram text messages to backend webhook contract with business_id=orange-park.

nodes.name: POST Backend
nodes.notes: Posts the normalized Orange Park Telegram payload to the backend. Dialog v3 and Bitrix contact sync are backend-owned.

nodes.name: Shape Telegram Reply
nodes.notes: Returns backend AI reply or a safe manager-handoff fallback when backend success is false.

nodes.name: Telegram Send Message
nodes.notes: Sends the backend reply to the original Telegram chat using the Orange Park bot credential.
